q: 18 अगस्त 2026 को घोषित राष्ट्रीय खेल पुरस्कार 2025 में कितने खिलाड़ियों को अर्जुन पुरस्कार प्रदान किया गया, जबकि कोई मेजर ध्यानचंद खेल रत्न पुरस्कार नहीं दिया गया?
e: On 18 August 2026, the National Sports Awards 2025 were announced with 17 Arjuna Awardees and no Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna Award conferred (17 खिलाड़ियों को अर्जुन पुरस्कार दिया गया तथा कोई खेल रत्न नहीं दिया गया). Exam Boosters: (1) National Sports Day in India is celebrated on 29 August on Major Dhyan Chand's birth anniversary; (2) Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna Award (instituted 1991–92) is India's highest sporting honour (first recipient: Viswanathan Anand); (3) Arjuna Award was instituted in 1961; (4) Dronacharya Award (1985) honours outstanding sports coaches.
qe: In the National Sports Awards 2025 announced on 18 August 2026, how many sportspersons were conferred the Arjuna Award, while no Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna Award was conferred?

q: अक्टूबर 2026 में की गई घोषणा के अनुसार, इसरो (ISRO) ने वर्ष 2029 तक भारत में कितने सक्रिय रॉकेट प्रक्षेपण स्थल (launch sites) संचालित करने का लक्ष्य रखा है?
e: In October 2026, ISRO outlined plans to have four active launch sites operational by 2029 to scale up launch cadence for commercial and deep-space missions (इसरो का लक्ष्य 2029 तक चार सक्रिय प्रक्षेपण स्थल संचालित करना है). Exam Boosters: (1) Satish Dhawan Space Centre (SDSC) at Sriharikota (Andhra Pradesh) is India's primary orbital spaceport; (2) A second orbital spaceport is being developed at Kulasekarapattinam in Thoothukudi district, Tamil Nadu (especially for SSLV); (3) Thumba Equatorial Rocket Launching Station (TERLS, Thiruvananthapuram) launched India's first sounding rocket in 1963; (4) IN-SPACe regulates private space sector participation in India.
qe: As announced in October 2026, how many active rocket launch sites does ISRO target to have operational across India by the year 2029?

q: अक्टूबर 2026 में भारत सरकार ने 'ग्रीन एनर्जी कॉरिडोर' योजना के चरण III को मुख्य रूप से किस उद्देश्य से मंजूरी दी?
o: Replace all state highways with solar-panelled roads
Build coastal desalination plants using tidal energy
Evacuate and integrate renewable energy into the national grid
e: The Green Energy Corridor (GEC) scheme (Phase III approved in Oct 2026) builds dedicated intra-state and inter-state transmission infrastructure to evacuate renewable energy (solar/wind) and integrate it smoothly into the national power grid (नवीकरणीय ऊर्जा को राष्ट्रीय ग्रिड से जोड़ने हेतु). Exam Boosters: (1) Implemented by the Ministry of New and Renewable Energy (MNRE); (2) India targets 500 GW of non-fossil fuel installed electricity capacity by 2030; (3) Phase II of GEC covered 7 renewable-rich states including Gujarat, Rajasthan, and Uttar Pradesh; (4) India's Net Zero carbon emission target year is 2070.
qe: In October 2026, the Government of India approved Phase III of the 'Green Energy Corridor' scheme primarily to:
oe: Replace all state highways with solar-panelled roads
Build coastal desalination plants using tidal energy
Evacuate and integrate renewable energy into the national grid

q: अक्टूबर 2026 में जारी उद्योगों के वार्षिक सर्वेक्षण (ASI) 2024–25 की रिपोर्ट के अनुसार, भारत के विनिर्माण उत्पादन (manufacturing output) में कितने प्रतिशत की वृद्धि हुई?
e: As per the ASI 2024–25 report released in October 2026, India's manufacturing output registered a growth of 7.81% (ASI 2024–25 के अनुसार भारत के विनिर्माण उत्पादन में 7.81% की वृद्धि हुई). Exam Boosters: (1) ASI is conducted annually by the National Statistical Office (NSO) under MoSPI; (2) It covers all factories registered under Sections 2m(i) and 2m(ii) of the Factories Act, 1948; (3) Index of Industrial Production (IIP) has base year 2011–12 and covers Mining, Manufacturing, and Electricity; (4) Eight Core Industries hold 40.27% weight in IIP.
qe: According to the Annual Survey of Industries (ASI) 2024–25 report released in October 2026, by what percentage did India's manufacturing output grow?

q:
प्रथम अंतर्राष्ट्रीय मक्का सम्मेलन 2026 (नवंबर 2026) के संदर्भ में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार कीजिए:
कथन I: मक्का की खेती के क्षेत्रफल की दृष्टि से भारत विश्व में 4वें स्थान पर है।
कथन II: अनाज फसलों में उच्च आनुवंशिक उपज क्षमता के कारण मक्का को 'अनाजों की रानी' कहा जाता है।
उपर्युक्त कथनों में से कौन-सा/से सही है/हैं?
e: Both statements are correct: India holds 4th rank globally in maize acreage (highlighted at the First International Maize Conference in Nov 2026), and maize is known as the 'Queen of Cereals' (दोनों कथन सही हैं). Exam Boosters: (1) Maize is a C4 plant grown primarily as a Kharif crop in India (also Rabi in Bihar/South India); (2) Major maize-producing states in India include Karnataka, Madhya Pradesh, Bihar, and Maharashtra; (3) Maize is also a key feedstock for India's Ethanol Blending Programme (E20 target); (4) ICAR-Indian Institute of Maize Research (IIMR) is located in Ludhiana, Punjab.
qe:
Consider the following statements regarding the First International Maize Conference 2026 (November 2026):
Statement I: India ranks 4th globally in terms of area under maize cultivation.
Statement II: Maize is widely called the 'Queen of Cereals' due to its high genetic yield potential among cereal crops.
Which of the above statements is/are correct?

q: अक्टूबर 2026 में आयोजित प्री-COP31 जलवायु मंत्रिस्तरीय बैठक में भारत ने किस ऐतिहासिक अंतर्राष्ट्रीय जलवायु समझौते के प्रति अपनी प्रतिबद्धता दोहराई?
e: At Pre-COP31 in October 2026, India reaffirmed its commitment to the Paris Agreement (2015) and principles of equity and CBDR-RC (भारत ने पेरिस समझौते के प्रति अपनी प्रतिबद्धता दोहराई). Exam Boosters: (1) Paris Agreement was adopted at COP21 in December 2015 under UNFCCC; (2) CBDR-RC stands for Common But Differentiated Responsibilities and Respective Capabilities; (3) Basel Convention deals with hazardous waste movement, Stockholm with Persistent Organic Pollutants (POPs), and Minamata with Mercury; (4) India co-founded the International Solar Alliance (ISA) and Coalition for Disaster Resilient Infrastructure (CDRI).
qe: At the Pre-COP31 climate ministerial in October 2026, India reaffirmed its strong commitment to which landmark international climate accord?

q: निम्नलिखित में से कौन उत्तर प्रदेश के राजकीय वृक्ष और राजकीय पक्षी को क्रमशः सही दर्शाता है?
e: The State Tree of Uttar Pradesh is Ashoka (Saraca asoca) and the State Bird is Sarus Crane (सारस क्रेन) (उत्तर प्रदेश का राजकीय वृक्ष अशोक और राजकीय पक्षी सारस है). Exam Boosters: (1) State Animal of UP: Barasingha (Swamp Deer); (2) State Flower of UP: Palash (Tesu); (3) State Fish of UP: Chitala (Clown Knifefish); (4) State Emblem of UP (approved 1938): a circle with two fishes, a bow-and-arrow, and three wavy lines (Ganga-Yamuna confluence).
qe: Which of the following correctly identifies the State Tree and State Bird of Uttar Pradesh respectively?

q: जनगणना 2011 के अनुसार, उत्तर प्रदेश के किन जिलों में क्रमशः सर्वाधिक और न्यूनतम साक्षरता दर दर्ज की गई?
e: As per Census 2011, Gautam Buddha Nagar recorded the highest literacy rate in UP (80.12%), while Shravasti recorded the lowest (46.74%) (सर्वाधिक साक्षरता गौतम बुद्ध नगर तथा न्यूनतम श्रावस्ती में थी). Exam Boosters: (1) Overall literacy rate of UP (2011) was 67.7% (Male: 77.3%, Female: 57.2%); (2) Highest population district in UP: Prayagraj; Lowest population district: Mahoba; (3) Largest district by area: Lakhimpur Kheri; Smallest by area: Hapur; (4) Highest sex ratio district in UP: Jaunpur (1,024).
qe: According to Census 2011, which districts of Uttar Pradesh recorded the highest and lowest literacy rates respectively?

q:
उत्तर प्रदेश के निम्नलिखित प्रसिद्ध पारंपरिक मेलों को उनके संबंधित जिलों से सुमेलित कीजिए:
1. नौचंदी मेला — (a) आगरा
2. बटेश्वर मेला — (b) मेरठ
3. देवा शरीफ मेला — (c) बाराबंकी
4. ददरी मेला — (d) बलिया
e: Nauchandi Fair is held in Meerut; Bateshwar Fair (famous cattle fair) in Agra; Dewa Sharif Fair (Waris Ali Shah) in Barabanki; Dadri Fair in Ballia (सही मिलान 1-b, 2-a, 3-c, 4-d है). Exam Boosters: (1) Magh Mela / Kumbh Mela is held at Prayagraj; (2) Shakumbhari Devi Fair is held in Saharanpur; (3) Syed Salar Fair is held in Bahraich; (4) Govind Sahab Fair is held in Ambedkar Nagar.
qe:
Match the following famous traditional fairs (Melas) of Uttar Pradesh with their respective districts:
1. Nauchandi Fair — (a) Agra
2. Bateshwar Fair — (b) Meerut
3. Dewa Sharif Fair — (c) Barabanki
4. Dadri Fair — (d) Ballia

q: उत्तर प्रदेश के सबसे पुराने आधुनिक विश्वविद्यालय 'इलाहाबाद विश्वविद्यालय' (जिसे 'पूर्व का ऑक्सफोर्ड' भी कहा जाता है) की स्थापना किस वर्ष हुई थी?
e: The University of Allahabad was established on 23 September 1887 (fourth oldest modern university in India after Calcutta, Bombay, and Madras) (इलाहाबाद विश्वविद्यालय की स्थापना 1887 में हुई थी). Exam Boosters: (1) Banaras Hindu University (BHU), Varanasi was founded in 1916 by Pandit Madan Mohan Malaviya; (2) Aligarh Muslim University (AMU) attained university status in 1920 (earlier MAO College, 1875 by Sir Syed Ahmad Khan); (3) Central Institute of Higher Tibetan Studies is at Sarnath; (4) Narora Atomic Power Station is in Bulandshahr district of UP.
qe: In which year was the University of Allahabad — the oldest modern university in Uttar Pradesh, often called the 'Oxford of the East' — established?

q: आयतन की दृष्टि से भारत की सबसे बड़ी कृत्रिम झील 'गोविंद बल्लभ पंत सागर' उत्तर प्रदेश के किस बाँध द्वारा निर्मित जलाशय है?
e: Rihand Dam (constructed on the Rihand River, a tributary of Son River, at Pipri in Sonbhadra district) creates the Govind Ballabh Pant Sagar reservoir (रिहंद बाँध, सोनभद्र द्वारा गोविंद बल्लभ पंत सागर निर्मित है). Exam Boosters: (1) Matatila Dam and Rajghat Dam are located on the Betwa River (Lalitpur/Jhansi region); (2) Sonbhadra is the ONLY district in India that borders 4 states (Madhya Pradesh, Chhattisgarh, Jharkhand, and Bihar); (3) Singrauli/Sonbhadra is known as the 'Energy Capital of India'; (4) Govind Ballabh Pant was the first Chief Minister of Uttar Pradesh.
qe: Govind Ballabh Pant Sagar, India's largest artificial lake by volume, is the reservoir created by which dam in Uttar Pradesh?

q: सूर्य देवता सवितृ को समर्पित पवित्र 'गायत्री मंत्र' ऋग्वेद के किस मंडल में संकलित है?
e: The Gayatri Mantra (composed by Sage Vishwamitra) is found in the Third Mandala of the Rigveda (गायत्री मंत्र ऋग्वेद के तृतीय मंडल में है). Exam Boosters: (1) Rigveda has 10 Mandalas and 1,028 hymns (Suktas); (2) Purusha Sukta (describing the four varnas) is in the Tenth Mandala; (3) Ninth Mandala is completely dedicated to Soma; (4) 'Satyameva Jayate' is taken from the Mundaka Upanishad.
qe: The sacred 'Gayatri Mantra', dedicated to the solar deity Savitr, is contained in which Mandala of the Rigveda?

q: 1875 में बंबई में 'आर्य समाज' की स्थापना किसने की और 'वेदों की ओर लौटो' का आह्वान किया था?
e: Swami Dayananda Saraswati (original name Mula Shankara) founded Arya Samaj in 1875 and authored 'Satyarth Prakash' (स्वामी दयानंद सरस्वती ने 1875 में आर्य समाज की स्थापना की). Exam Boosters: (1) Raja Ram Mohan Roy founded Brahmo Samaj in 1828; (2) Swami Vivekananda founded Ramakrishna Mission in 1897; (3) Jyotirao Phule founded Satyashodhak Samaj in 1873 and wrote 'Gulamgiri'; (4) Swami Dayananda was the first to use the term 'Swaraj' and advocate Hindi as a national language.
qe: Who founded the 'Arya Samaj' in Bombay in 1875 and gave the call 'Back to the Vedas' (वेदों की ओर लौटो)?

q: 23 जून 1757 का निर्णायक प्लासी का युद्ध, जिसने भारत में ब्रिटिश राजनीतिक शासन की नींव रखी, रॉबर्ट क्लाइव और बंगाल के किस नवाब के बीच लड़ा गया था?
e: Robert Clive defeated Nawab Siraj-ud-Daulah at Plassey (Palashi, on the banks of Bhagirathi River) largely due to the betrayal of commander Mir Jafar (प्लासी का युद्ध रॉबर्ट क्लाइव और सिराजुद्दौला के बीच हुआ था). Exam Boosters: (1) Battle of Buxar (22 October 1764) was fought between Hector Munro and the combined forces of Mir Qasim, Shuja-ud-Daulah (Awadh), and Shah Alam II; (2) Treaty of Allahabad (1765) granted Diwani rights of Bengal, Bihar, and Orissa to the East India Company; (3) Dual Government in Bengal (1765–72) was introduced by Clive and abolished by Warren Hastings; (4) Warren Hastings became the first Governor-General of Bengal (Regulating Act, 1773).
qe: The decisive Battle of Plassey (23 June 1757), which laid the foundation of British political rule in India, was fought between Robert Clive and which Nawab of Bengal?

q: अक्टूबर 1943 में नेताजी सुभाष चंद्र बोस ने 'आजाद हिंद सरकार' (स्वतंत्र भारत की अस्थायी सरकार) के गठन की घोषणा कहाँ की थी?
e: On 21 October 1943, Subhas Chandra Bose proclaimed the Provisional Government of Azad Hind in Singapore and took command of the Indian National Army (INA) (21 अक्टूबर 1943 को सिंगापुर में आजाद हिंद सरकार की घोषणा की गई). Exam Boosters: (1) INA was originally conceived by Mohan Singh and Rash Behari Bose; (2) Rani of Jhansi Regiment (all-women regiment) was led by Captain Lakshmi Sahgal; (3) Netaji gave the slogans 'Delhi Chalo' and 'Tum Mujhe Khoon Do, Main Tumhe Azadi Dunga'; (4) 23 January (Netaji's birthday) is celebrated as 'Parakram Diwas'.
qe: In October 1943, where did Netaji Subhas Chandra Bose proclaim the formation of the Provisional Government of Free India ('Azad Hind Sarkar')?

q:
भक्ति आंदोलन के निम्नलिखित आचार्यों को उनके प्रमुख दार्शनिक मत से सुमेलित कीजिए:
1. शंकराचार्य — (a) विशिष्टाद्वैतवाद
2. रामानुजाचार्य — (b) अद्वैत वेदांत
3. वल्लभाचार्य — (c) द्वैतवाद
4. माधवाचार्य — (d) शुद्धाद्वैतवाद
e: Shankaracharya — Advaita; Ramanujacharya — Vishishtadvaita; Vallabhacharya — Shuddhadvaita (Pushtimarg); Madhvacharya — Dvaita (सही मिलान 1-b, 2-a, 3-d, 4-c है). Exam Boosters: (1) Nimbarkacharya propounded Dvaitadvaita (Bhedabheda); (2) Chaitanya Mahaprabhu propounded Achintya Bhedabheda; (3) Ramananda bridged South and North Indian Bhakti traditions (disciples included Kabir, Ravidas, Dhanna, Pipa); (4) Tulsidas wrote Ramcharitmanas in Awadhi (1574 CE).
qe:
Match the following Bhakti Movement saints with their primary philosophical school / language tradition:
1. Shankaracharya — (a) Vishishtadvaita (Qualified Non-dualism)
2. Ramanujacharya — (b) Advaita Vedanta (Non-dualism)
3. Vallabhacharya — (c) Dvaita (Dualism)
4. Madhvacharya — (d) Shuddhadvaita (Pure Non-dualism)

q: राष्ट्रीय शिक्षा नीति (NEP) 2020 के अंतर्गत मौजूदा 10+2 विद्यालयी संरचना को किस नई पाठ्यचर्या और शैक्षणिक संरचना से प्रतिस्थापित किया गया है?
e: NEP 2020 introduces the 5+3+3+4 structure covering ages 3–18: Foundational (5 yrs), Preparatory (3 yrs), Middle (3 yrs), and Secondary (4 yrs) (NEP 2020 में 5+3+3+4 संरचना लागू की गई है). Exam Boosters: (1) NEP 2020 was drafted by a committee chaired by Dr. K. Kasturirangan; (2) Aims for 100% Gross Enrolment Ratio (GER) in school education by 2030 and 50% GER in higher education by 2035; (3) Recommends mother tongue/local language as medium of instruction at least up to Grade 5; (4) Proposes HECI (Higher Education Commission of India) as an overarching regulator.
qe: Under the National Education Policy (NEP) 2020, the existing 10+2 school structure has been replaced by which new curricular and pedagogical structure?

q: भारतीय संविधान का कौन-सा अनुच्छेद चुनावों के अधीक्षण, निर्देशन और नियंत्रण के लिए एक स्वतंत्र भारत निर्वाचन आयोग का प्रावधान करता है?
e: Article 324 (Part XV) establishes the Election Commission of India (अनुच्छेद 324 भारत निर्वाचन आयोग से संबंधित है). Exam Boosters: (1) Sukumar Sen was India's first Chief Election Commissioner (1950); (2) 61st Constitutional Amendment Act (1988) lowered the voting age from 21 to 18 years (Article 326); (3) Article 315 deals with UPSC and State PSCs; (4) National Voters' Day is celebrated on 25 January (ECI foundation day, 25 Jan 1950).
qe: Which Article of the Indian Constitution provides for an independent Election Commission of India to superintend, direct, and control elections?

q: 42वें संविधान संशोधन अधिनियम, 1976 द्वारा भारतीय संविधान की प्रस्तावना में कौन-से तीन शब्द जोड़े गए थे?
e: The 42nd Amendment Act, 1976 (the ONLY amendment ever made to the Preamble) added 'Socialist', 'Secular', and 'Integrity' (समाजवादी, पंथनिरपेक्ष और अखंडता). Exam Boosters: (1) In Kesavananda Bharati case (1973), Supreme Court held that the Preamble is an integral part of the Constitution and subject to the Basic Structure Doctrine; (2) Objective Resolution moved by Jawaharlal Nehru on 13 Dec 1946 formed the basis of the Preamble; (3) Ideas of Liberty, Equality, Fraternity were inspired by the French Revolution; (4) Constitution was adopted on 26 November 1949 (Constitution Day).
qe: Which three words were added to the Preamble of the Indian Constitution by the 42nd Constitutional Amendment Act, 1976?

q: पूरे भारत में शिक्षक शिक्षा (teacher education) के मानकों और मानदंडों को विनियमित करने के लिए संसद के एक अधिनियम (1993) के तहत 1995 में किस वैधानिक निकाय की स्थापना की गई थी?
e: NCTE (National Council for Teacher Education) became a statutory body on 17 August 1995 under the NCTE Act, 1993 (राष्ट्रीय अध्यापक शिक्षा परिषद की स्थापना 1993 के अधिनियम के तहत 1995 में हुई). Exam Boosters: (1) UGC became a statutory body under the UGC Act, 1956; (2) NCERT was established in 1961 as an autonomous society (not statutory); (3) AICTE regulates technical education (statutory status in 1987); (4) NAAC (1994, Bengaluru) assesses and accredits higher education institutions.
qe: Which statutory body was established in 1995 under an Act of Parliament (1993) to regulate standards and norms for teacher education across India?

q: भारतीय संविधान के अनुच्छेद 51A के अंतर्गत मौलिक कर्तव्यों के संबंध में निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा कथन सही नहीं है?
o: Currently there are 11 Fundamental Duties listed in Article 51A.
They apply only to citizens of India, not to foreigners.
They are directly enforceable in courts through writs under Article 32.
The 11th Fundamental Duty (education of children 6–14) was added in 2002.
e: Fundamental Duties are NON-JUSTICIABLE (not directly enforceable by writs under Article 32), though Parliament can enact laws to enforce specific duties (मौलिक कर्तव्य वाद-योग्य नहीं हैं). Exam Boosters: (1) Originally 10 Fundamental Duties were added by the 42nd Amendment (1976); (2) Inspired by the Constitution of the former USSR; (3) Verma Committee (1999) identified legal provisions for implementation of Fundamental Duties; (4) 11th Duty [51A(k)] was added by the 86th Amendment Act, 2002.
qe: Which of the following statements about Fundamental Duties under Article 51A of the Indian Constitution is NOT correct?
oe: Currently there are 11 Fundamental Duties listed in Article 51A.
They apply only to citizens of India, not to foreigners.
They are directly enforceable in courts through writs under Article 32.
The 11th Fundamental Duty (education of children 6–14) was added in 2002.

q: भारत की सबसे बड़ी खारे पानी की लैगून झील और विश्व की दूसरी सबसे बड़ी तटीय लैगून झील कौन-सी है?
e: Chilika Lake (located in Odisha at the mouth of the Daya River) is India's largest brackish water lagoon and a famous Ramsar site (चिल्का झील, ओडिशा भारत की सबसे बड़ी खारे पानी की लैगून है). Exam Boosters: (1) Wular Lake (Jammu & Kashmir) is India's largest freshwater lake; (2) Sambhar Lake (Rajasthan) is India's largest inland salt lake; (3) Vembanad Lake (Kerala) is India's longest lake; (4) Loktak Lake (Manipur) is famous for floating phumdis and Keibul Lamjao National Park.
qe: Which is the largest brackish water lagoon in India and the second largest coastal lagoon in the world?

q: उत्तर-पश्चिम भारत (पंजाब, हरियाणा, पश्चिमी यूपी) में शीतकालीन वर्षा, जो रबी की गेहूँ फसल के लिए अत्यंत लाभदायक है, मुख्य रूप से किसके कारण होती है?
o: Tropical Cyclones from Bay of Bengal
e: Western Disturbances (पश्चिमी विक्षोभ) are extra-tropical storms originating over the Mediterranean Sea, brought to North-West India by the Subtropical Westerly Jet Stream during winter. Exam Boosters: (1) Retreating (North-East) Monsoon causes winter rainfall along the Coromandel Coast (Tamil Nadu); (2) 'Mango Showers' occur in Kerala/Karnataka and 'Kalbaisakhi' (Nor'westers) in West Bengal/Assam during pre-monsoon; (3) Mawsynram (Meghalaya) receives the highest average annual rainfall in the world; (4) El Niño generally weakens the Indian South-West Monsoon.
qe: Winter rainfall in North-West India (Punjab, Haryana, Western UP), which is highly beneficial for the Rabi wheat crop, is primarily caused by:
oe: Tropical Cyclones from Bay of Bengal

q: जनगणना 2011 के अनुसार, कौन-सा युग्म क्रमशः क्षेत्रफल की दृष्टि से भारत के सबसे छोटे राज्य और जनसंख्या की दृष्टि से सबसे छोटे राज्य को सही दर्शाता है?
e: Goa (3,702 sq. km) is India's smallest state by area, while Sikkim (~6.10 lakh population in 2011) is India's least populous state (क्षेत्रफल में सबसे छोटा राज्य गोवा और जनसंख्या में सबसे छोटा सिक्किम है). Exam Boosters: (1) Largest state by area: Rajasthan (followed by MP, Maharashtra, UP); (2) Most populous state: Uttar Pradesh (~16.5% of India's population); (3) Only Indian state to record negative decadal population growth (−0.6%) during 2001–2011: Nagaland; (4) India's first synchronous census was conducted in 1881 under Lord Ripon.
qe: According to Census 2011, which pair correctly represents India's smallest state by geographical area and least populous state respectively?

q: राष्ट्रीय कृषि और ग्रामीण विकास बैंक (नाबार्ड) की स्थापना 12 जुलाई 1982 को किस समिति की सिफारिश पर की गई थी?
e: NABARD was established on 12 July 1982 (headquartered in Mumbai) based on the B. Sivaraman Committee (CRAFICARD) recommendation (नाबार्ड की स्थापना बी. शिवरामन समिति की सिफारिश पर हुई). Exam Boosters: (1) Narasimham Committee dealt with Banking Sector Reforms (1991 & 1998); (2) Rangarajan & Tendulkar Committees dealt with poverty estimation; (3) SIDBI (1990, headquartered in Lucknow, UP) is the apex institution for MSMEs; (4) RBI was established on 1 April 1935 (Hilton Young Commission) and nationalized on 1 January 1949.
qe: NABARD (National Bank for Agriculture and Rural Development) was established on 12 July 1982 on the recommendation of which committee?

q: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सी गतिविधि भारतीय अर्थव्यवस्था के 'तृतीयक क्षेत्र' (सेवा क्षेत्र) के अंतर्गत आती है?
e: Banking, transport, communication, trade, and education constitute the Tertiary (Service) Sector, which contributes over 50% of India's GDP (बैंकिंग, परिवहन और शिक्षा तृतीयक क्षेत्र में आते हैं). Exam Boosters: (1) Primary Sector: Agriculture, forestry, fishing, mining (extracting natural resources); (2) Secondary Sector: Manufacturing, construction, electricity/gas/water supply; (3) Quaternary Sector: Knowledge-based IT, R&D, and consultancy; (4) Tertiary sector is the largest contributor to India's GDP, while Primary sector still employs the largest workforce share.
qe: Which of the following activities belongs to the 'Tertiary Sector' (Service Sector) of the Indian economy?

q: जब भारतीय रिज़र्व बैंक (RBI) नकद आरक्षित अनुपात (CRR) में वृद्धि करता है, तो अर्थव्यवस्था पर इसका तात्कालिक प्रभाव क्या होता है?
o: Money supply increases and inflation rises
Fiscal deficit of the government automatically falls
Commercial banks earn higher interest from RBI on CRR
Banks' lending capacity decreases and money supply contracts
e: Increasing CRR requires commercial banks to park a higher fraction of their Net Demand and Time Liabilities (NDTL) as cash with RBI (earning NO interest), thereby reducing lendable funds and contracting money supply to curb inflation (CRR बढ़ने से बैंकों की ऋण देने की क्षमता और मुद्रा आपूर्ति घटती है). Exam Boosters: (1) CRR is maintained in cash only with RBI under RBI Act, 1934; (2) SLR (Statutory Liquidity Ratio) is maintained by banks with themselves in cash, gold, or approved government securities; (3) Raising Repo Rate and CRR are contractionary ('hawkish') monetary policies; (4) Monetary Policy Committee (MPC) has 6 members (3 RBI + 3 Govt) chaired by the RBI Governor.
qe: When the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) increases the Cash Reserve Ratio (CRR), what is its immediate effect on the economy?
oe: Money supply increases and inflation rises
Fiscal deficit of the government automatically falls
Commercial banks earn higher interest from RBI on CRR
Banks' lending capacity decreases and money supply contracts

q: 'शुष्क बर्फ' (Dry Ice), जिसका उपयोग प्रशीतन (refrigeration) में होता है, किस यौगिक का ठोस रूप है?
e: Dry ice is solid Carbon dioxide (CO₂), which sublimes directly from solid to gas at −78.5°C without melting into a liquid (शुष्क बर्फ ठोस कार्बन डाइऑक्साइड है). Exam Boosters: (1) Sublimation is direct solid-to-gas transition (also seen in camphor, naphthalene, iodine, ammonium chloride); (2) Laughing gas is Nitrous oxide (N₂O); (3) Marsh gas is Methane (CH₄); (4) Tear gas commonly uses Chloropicrin or CS gas.
qe: 'Dry Ice', widely used for refrigeration and theatrical fog effects, is the solid form of which compound?

q: इंसुलिन, एक पेप्टाइड हार्मोन जो रक्त में ग्लूकोज के स्तर को नियंत्रित करता है, किस अंग में स्थित लैंगरहैंस की द्वीपिकाओं की बीटा कोशिकाओं द्वारा स्रावित होता है?
e: Insulin is secreted by Beta cells of the Islets of Langerhans in the Pancreas (अग्न्याशय — a mixed/heterocrine gland). Deficiency or resistance causes Diabetes Mellitus (मधुमेह). Exam Boosters: (1) Alpha cells of pancreas secrete Glucagon (raises blood glucose); (2) Insulin contains Zinc (Zn) and was discovered by Frederick Banting and Charles Best (1921); (3) Pituitary gland is called the 'Master Gland', controlled by the Hypothalamus; (4) Adrenaline (epinephrine) is the 'fight-or-flight' emergency hormone.
qe: Insulin, a peptide hormone that regulates blood glucose levels, is secreted by the Beta cells of the Islets of Langerhans located in which organ?

q: कंप्यूटर नेटवर्किंग और ICT में संक्षिप्ताक्षर 'HTTPS' का पूर्ण रूप क्या है, और सामान्य HTTP की तुलना में इसकी सुरक्षा कौन सुनिश्चित करता है?
o: HyperText Transfer Protocol Secure; encryption via TLS/SSL
High-Speed Text Transmission System; fiber optic cables
HyperText Terminal Processing Standard; BIOS firewall
Hybrid Transfer Text Protocol Service; RAM caching
e: HTTPS stands for HyperText Transfer Protocol Secure, which encrypts data exchanged between web browsers and servers using TLS/SSL protocols (HTTPS = हाइपरटेक्स्ट ट्रांसफर प्रोटोकॉल सिक्योर, जो TLS/SSL एन्क्रिप्शन का उपयोग करता है). Exam Boosters: (1) HTTP uses Port 80 while HTTPS uses Port 443; (2) URL stands for Uniform Resource Locator and DNS for Domain Name System; (3) RAM is volatile primary memory, whereas ROM is non-volatile; (4) Tim Berners-Lee invented the World Wide Web (WWW) and HTTP in 1989.
qe: In computer networking and ICT, what does the acronym 'HTTPS' stand for, and what ensures its security over standard HTTP?
oe: HyperText Transfer Protocol Secure; encryption via TLS/SSL
High-Speed Text Transmission System; fiber optic cables
HyperText Terminal Processing Standard; BIOS firewall
Hybrid Transfer Text Protocol Service; RAM caching
